Incumbent [[Governor of Nevada|Governor]] [[Kenny Guinn]] could not run due to [[Term limits in the United States|term limits]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Congressman [[Jim Gibbons (American politician)|Jim Gibbons]] defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] State Senator [[Dina Titus]].
